Summary recommendation (BOE):
- GPU type: 2x A10G-equivalent nodes (quantized LLM variant supported), 1 control plane node in the same region. 
- Instance count: 4 worker GPUs (2 nodes), initial config supports ~200 concurrent sessions at median 320 tokens with 20% headroom; burst capacity planning: configure routing to allow spillover to hosted endpoints in our us-east region for prolonged spikes.
- KV cache: provision 200GB KV cache across the pool to keep prefix/cache hit rates reasonable for pilot prompts.
- Expected provisioning lead time: 5 business days once order/commit is received (networking/VPC peering and KMS exchange are the main blockers).
- Cost delta: estimate attached minipool-sku-pricing.pdf — approx 1.6x on-demand for the short 3-month committed tranche (includes reserved capacity discount and setup fee).

- Need Soojin to confirm KMS/HSM policy for Nimbus's tenant and Monica to confirm whether we can use regional IP allowlist for their pilot testers.
- Suggest a canary cutover: start routing 10% of traffic for 48 hours post-provisioning, monitor token-level latency/99th pct, then ramp.

I'll drop a quick BOE doc into the provisioning folder.

- Karthik
